title: Stovetop Jasmine Rice
summary: Fluffy jasmine rice in a saucepan: 12 minutes on the lowest heat, then 10 more with the lid shut. No peeking.

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain it.
Put the rice and the water in a saucepan and bring it to the boil, uncovered, over a medium-high heat.
As soon as it boils, put the lid on fully, turn the heat down to its lowest setting and cook for {timer:12|rice}. Do not open the lid or stir the rice.
Turn off the heat and leave the lid closed for another {timer:10|rice rest}.
Open the lid and fluff the rice gently with a fork.

tips: If the water is still bubbling hard under the lid, turn the heat down. The rice should steam gently, not boil over.
